clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir 'Belonging' Released Amid Political Debate
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi released her memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, detailing her personal life and political path.
The book discusses topics including family tragedies, her marriage, and the decision to decline the position of prime minister.

clusters.headline: Severe Air Pollution Spikes Across Indian Cities Following Deepavali
aiSummaryBullets: New Delhi recorded its highest pollution levels in five years following the Deepavali holiday.
Mumbai's air quality index rose significantly despite official bans on firecracker use in public spaces.

clusters.headline: CISCE Releases 2027 Examination Timetables For Class 10 And 12
aiSummaryBullets: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) released official timetables for the 2027 board sessions.
ISC Class 12 examinations are scheduled to take place between February 9 and April 8, 2027.

clusters.headline: 'Why are we becoming Vishwaguru in air pollution?' Congress questions PM Modi
aiSummaryBullets: Times of India reports: 'Why are we becoming Vishwaguru in air pollution?' Congress questions PM Modi
The Hindu reports: 'Notebandi' devastated economy, 'votebandi' destroying polity: Congress slams PM Modi

clusters.headline: Qantas Announces Plans To Outsource Eight Hundred Fifty Local Jobs
aiSummaryBullets: Qantas intends to outsource 850 corporate roles to the consultancy firm Accenture.
The airline stated that a majority of these positions will be relocated to India.

clusters.headline: Indian Government Condemns Alleged Misrepresentation By Vloggers
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian Ministry of External Affairs has officially denounced a digital campaign involving Chinese content creators.
Reports indicate that approximately 150 individuals are filming impoverished districts in Bangladesh to portray them as Indian locations.

clusters.headline: Election Commission Updates Model Code For Retired State Officials
aiSummaryBullets: The Election Commission of India has expanded model code of conduct restrictions to include retired government staff.
These individuals are now required to maintain political neutrality during the electoral process.

clusters.headline: Regional Authorities Expand Ethanol Fuel Testing Following Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Keralam authorities have begun collecting petrol samples from various fuel stations to verify ethanol content following reports from Karnataka.
Karnataka officials conducted tests at 67 locations after finding ethanol levels reaching up to 31% in samples, exceeding the mandated E20 blend.

clusters.headline: India And Global Communities Celebrate The Annual Diwali Festival
aiSummaryBullets: Diwali festivities across India include prayer services, traditional rangoli patterns, fireworks, and the sharing of sweets.
Major celebrations were held in Ayodhya, involving drone displays, light shows, and theatrical performances based on the Hindu epic Ramayana.

clusters.headline: Indian Cities Prepare Official Arrangements For Chhath Puja 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Delhi government declared November 16, 2026, a public holiday for Chhath Puja, closing schools and government offices.
Telangana officials designated 28 locations in Hyderabad for the observance of the festival scheduled from November 13 to 16.
